verdict:
NO ENTRY, and no court - but keep the name, because the floor is hard and self-rising.

THE SCREEN PREMISE IS AN ARTIFACT TWICE OVER. LTBR is tagged Basic Materials / Major Chemicals; it is a pre-revenue nuclear-fuel R&D company with zero revenue in every quarter on record, so the 'excess vs Basic Materials median -0.417' compares it to nothing meaningful. And the -71.6% dd52 is the deflation of a speculative nuclear-theme peak plus real dilution: shares went 33.41M to 37.40M in six months (+12%) and +68% year over year. The triage's DAMAGE-ABSENT-vacuously label is right - there are no operating numbers in which damage could appear - and it correctly warns not to read that as bullish.

WHAT IS ACTUALLY HERE. $237.5M cash against $2.05M of total liabilities, no debt, no preferred, at 6/30/26; net cash ~$6.29/share on 37.4M shares; burn ~$16.6M/yr net of interest income, so the runway is measured in decades, not quarters. At the pack's $8.45 that is 1.34x net cash, ~$81M of enterprise value for the entire fuel program. The one genuinely under-appreciated mechanic - and the thing worth a KG entry - is that the ATM has been ACCRETIVE to the floor: 3.8M shares sold at ~$11.68 average against $6.29 net cash/share means each raise lifted cash-per-share while diluting the option. The floor rises as the company sells.

WHY NO COURT AND NO ENTRY. The residual question is what an unlicensed, pre-revenue fuel concept is worth, with first post-irradiation examination only BEGINNING later in 2026. Nothing adjudicates that: $81M of EV is as defensible as too-high as too-low, and the live ATM means any move toward the option value gets partially sold into by the issuer. There is no dated catalyst between here and November. A bench cannot manufacture information that does not exist yet - the PIE program will.

GATE DESIGN NOTE (beta-carrier test applied): LTBR's tape is high-beta to the nuclear/uranium theme, so a naked price gate would fire on sector de-rating. But this is the rare case where a conditioned gate anchors to something idiosyncratic and self-updating: NET CASH PER SHARE, recomputed each print for ATM activity. A gate at ~1.10x current net-cash/share (the level the $6.92 52-week low already tested) is thesis-consistent because the floor is cash, not multiple. Do not anchor to a fixed dollar price - the ATM moves the floor every quarter.
blue_ruling: TRIAGE-ONLY - no benches convened. Court-worthiness 5/10, below the 6/10 dispatch threshold, and I concur with holding it there: the triage's own summary is correct that a court would return its answer at venture-starter sizing either way. Adjudicated from the REFUTABILITY artifact plus the queue row.
reopen_gates: EVENT (primary): first post-irradiation examination (PIE) results or any dated PIE milestone disclosure - this is the only event that converts the venture prior into gradeable evidence. Re-court on the data, not the price.

PRICE (conditioned, self-updating anchor): price at or below ~1.10x CURRENT net-cash-per-share (recompute from the latest 10-Q for ATM issuance; ~$6.90-7.00 on the 6/30/26 balance sheet) AND no adverse PIE news outstanding. Anchor to the cash floor, never to a fixed dollar level.
DATA: two consecutive quarters with share count flat within 2% (ATM paused) - removes the issuer-sells-into-strength overhang that caps any re-rating.
EVENT: a fuel-qualification partnership, DOE award, or utility MOU with named counterparty - would give the $81M EV an external mark for the first time.

VERIFY (open item from triage): the 2026-08-11 Form 144 (0001974158-26-000097) was a PROPOSED insider sale after the 8/6 RSA grant - confirm whether it executed before treating insider behavior as signal either way.
